Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Omaha, Nebraska, had no connection to the state of Texas or its capital, Austin. While it is true that Omaha is not the capital of Texas, the question explicitly asks for the year when Omaha became the capital of the state Beyoncé Knowles is from (Texas). The Planner incorrectly interpreted "capital" to mean the "statehouse" and provided the year 1888 (completion of the Texas State Capitol building) instead of the correct year, 1839, when Austin was officially designated the capital of Texas. This misinterpretation and the oversight of the actual historical designation led to the incorrect solution.
